title: potentilla fruticosa var. parvifolia
intro: Potentilla fruticosa var. parvifolia, commonly known as dwarf shrub potentilla, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Potentilla fruticosa var. parvifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
